title: BiggerPockets Alternatives
h1: BiggerPockets alternatives, by the job you need done
keyLine: Match the next site or class to the job, not to a brand.
description: Honest BiggerPockets alternatives by job: free community, deal math, coaching, tax class, or a written wealth plan. Public prices, dated sources.
answer: BiggerPockets is a real estate site with free forums, free podcasts, and a paid Pro membership. It helps you study deals. It is not a full money plan. If you want something else, pick by the job: a cheap community, a deal calculator, a coach, a tax class, or a written plan. Free BiggerPockets content is enough to start. Pay only when a tool or a person would save you time.
criteriaIntro: This list is not a software bake-off. Other sites already rank lead tools against BiggerPockets Pro. We grouped live education and coaching options by the job a normal investor actually has.
criteria: The option teaches real estate or a wider money plan, and we opened a public page for it.
We say the format: free community, paid membership, course, coaching, or a tax firm class.
Price comes from a public page, or we say it is not published.
We include Legacy Wealth Blueprint and say we sell it.

blocks.heading: What BiggerPockets is
paragraphs: BiggerPockets is a real estate media and community company. You can read forums, listen to podcasts, and use deal tools. A [staff post on March 3, 2026](https://www.biggerpockets.com/forums/48/topics/1280018-new-to-biggerpockets-pro-insurance-and-loan-discounts) said Pro costs $32.50 a month when billed once a year. A [membership comparison page](https://blogdev.biggerpockets.com/membership-types) also lists Pro at $39 a month, or $32.50 a month billed yearly.

The [bootcamps URL](https://www.biggerpockets.com/bootcamps) we opened on September 15, 2026 showed free guides and a prompt to upgrade to Pro. It did not show a live checkout price. An older membership table lists online bootcamps at $199 each. Confirm the current class on their site.

You do not need an alternative if the free forums and podcasts already answer your questions. You need a different product when you want a coach, a tax plan, or help with debt and payroll, not just rentals.

blocks.heading: Alternatives by job
blocks.intro: Start with the job. Then look at price.

items.name: Stay free: forums and podcasts
items.summary: Keep using BiggerPockets forums plus the [BiggerPockets Real Estate Podcast](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/biggerpockets-real-estate-podcast/id594419649) and [Real Estate Rookie](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/real-estate-rookie/id1499646507). Reddit real estate threads are free too, but quality varies.

items.name: KenPro (Ken McElroy)
items.summary: A paid membership around rental and apartment education. [Ken's store page](https://kenmcelroy.com/kenprostore/) lists Ken Pro at $39.99 a month or $399 a year. Older pages still show $29.99. Use the live store price.
items.meta: Job: cheap paid lessons without a high-ticket call

items.name: BetterLife (Brandon Turner)
items.summary: Brandon Turner used to host BiggerPockets shows. [BetterLife](https://abetterlife.com/home-2/) now sells the Tribe and other coaching. The public pages we opened do not list a checkout price. The Tribe page says it is for people who already did at least one rental, flip, or passive deal this year.
items.meta: Job: coaching after you already own a deal. Price on request.

items.name: SubTo (Pace Morby)
items.summary: [SubTo](https://subto.com/) teaches creative finance, including buying a home 'subject to' the seller's loan. That is an advanced tactic with legal and loan risk. The homepage does not print a price. The [join page](https://buy.subto.com/) we opened listed $9,800, or four payments of $2,450. Their own disclaimer says results are not typical. Full map: [SubTo alternatives](/compare/subto-alternatives).
items.meta: Job: creative finance community. $9,800 on the checkout page we opened.

items.name: WealthAbility Live (Tom Wheelwright, CPA)
items.summary: Tom Wheelwright wrote Tax-Free Wealth and is a Rich Dad advisor. [WealthAbility Live](https://www.wealthability.com/wealthability-live/) lists $197 a month for live tax sessions and a community. It is tax education, not a BiggerPockets clone.
items.meta: Job: tax class for owners and investors

items.name: A fee-only planner or CPA
items.summary: If you need advice on your file, buy hours from a licensed person, not a forum. The [FTC](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/when-business-offer-or-coaching-program-scam) warns that coaching programs which promise easy real estate profits are often a scam. A CPA files returns. A coach does not.
items.meta: Job: advice on your numbers. Fee varies.

items.name: Legacy Wealth Blueprint
items.summary: Our program. It is a 12-month wealth plan covering tax, debt, income, investing, and protection, not a deal-finding bootcamp. We publish the price as $9,800 cash or card in [our tax program comparison](/blog/best-tax-strategy-programs-w2-earners-over-250k). Confirm it in writing on the call. Skip it if you only want to underwrite rentals.
items.meta: Job: one written plan for tax, debt, and investing. We sell this.

blocks.label: Watch for this
paragraphs: Many 'BiggerPockets alternatives' articles are ranking software: PropStream, DealMachine, Roofstock. Those help you find or buy a property. They do not replace education. If a page ranks 11 tools and never says who wrote it, treat it as a lead list, not a guide.

blocks.heading: How to choose in 20 minutes
paragraphs: Write one sentence: 'I need help with ___ this quarter.' If the blank is 'my first rental numbers,' stay free or buy Pro for the calculators. If the blank is 'my tax bill after a W-2 raise,' a tax class or a CPA fits better than a landlord forum. If the blank is 'someone to review my deal,' that is coaching, and you should read [real estate coaching vs a course](/compare/real-estate-coaching-vs-course) first.
bullets: Do not buy a high-ticket program to learn what a free podcast already teaches.
Do not buy coaching with a credit card you cannot pay off. The [FTC](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/when-business-offer-or-coaching-program-scam) says that pattern shows up in coaching scams.
If you work full time, see our sourced list of [real estate courses for people with a day job](/blog/best-real-estate-investing-courses-full-time-job).

whoFits: You already used free BiggerPockets content and you can name the next job: community, math, coaching, or tax.
You want a fair map of other live brands, including ones we do not sell.
whoSkips: You have not listened to a single episode or read a forum thread yet. Start free.
You want a ranked list of skip-tracing apps. That is a different search.

questionsBeforeBuying: What job will this purchase do in the next 90 days that free content will not?
What is the full price, including a second payment or upsell?
Can I use the forums and podcasts for 30 days and still have the same need?
Who reviews my actual deal or tax file, and how fast do they reply?
Send me the refund terms in writing.
nextSteps: Listen to one BiggerPockets episode and write the model you want: long-term rental, short-term rental, or none.
Run a sample deal in the [rental cash flow calculator](/tools/rental-property-cash-flow).
If tax is the real pain, open [tax strategies for W-2 employees](/tax-strategies/for/w2-employees) before you buy any real estate class.

faqs.q: Is there a free BiggerPockets alternative?
faqs.a: Yes. The free BiggerPockets forums and podcasts are the first alternative to paying. Reddit is also free. Paid options start when you want structure, a calculator pack, or a person.
A March 3, 2026 BiggerPockets staff post said $32.50 a month billed yearly. A membership table also shows $39 a month. Check biggerpockets.com before you buy.

faqs.q: Is Legacy Wealth Blueprint a BiggerPockets alternative?
faqs.a: Only if your job is a full money plan. It is not a deal marketplace or a landlord forum. If you only want to find rentals, a BiggerPockets bootcamp or KenPro is a closer match and often cheaper.
PropStream is a data tool, not a class. Buy data when you are already looking at markets. Do not buy it to learn what a rental is.
